data.content_ref: inline:The isolated node abstracts to SRC_003: both reduce to the 'single trajectory' problem — one run-record is one sample from the joint distribution P(claim, verdict), so it cannot support a population-level claim about verification independence. REFUTED IF: a single run-record is shown to carry population-level information (e.g., via an internal execution trace with n independent deterministic sub-checks, making one record many samples) — then the trajectory is not n=1 and the reduction to SRC_003's single-data-point critique fails.
